_description: RF-sparse observation site: the gateway unit is DISABLED by the 'collector' fleet role (bridge intentionally off — the box hears too few nodes to be worth bridging). This config is kept on disk so the box can be promoted to a bridging role without re-authoring; 'enabled': false documents the declared intent at the config layer too.
_usage: cp collector.json ~/.config/meshforge/gateway.json && edit every <PLACEHOLDER>. Pair with the 'collector' fleet role (provision_role.py disables meshforge-gateway). Map/telemetry services keep running; only the bridge is off.
